description: This file implements a synchronous host resolver using a dedicated thread, leveraging Chromium's base threading and networking libraries. It defines a ResolverThread class that performs DNS resolution asynchronously and a static method for external resolution calls.

classes.name: ResolverThread
classes.description: A thread class that performs DNS resolution asynchronously using Chromium's network stack.

methods.name: ResolverThread::Resolve
methods.description: Initiates DNS resolution on the resolver thread and waits for completion.

methods.name: SynchronousHostResolver::Resolve
methods.description: Static method to perform synchronous DNS resolution using ResolverThread.
